tools.name: library_missing

tools.name: queue_status

tools.name: queue_log
tools.description: One job's record and the tail of its log if a local copy exists; otherwise where the remote log is and how to fetch it.

tools.name: queue_add
tools.description: File a committed experiment script on the lab queue for an env profile (default: policy.run); the next queue tick submits it. In dry-run mode (the default until the lab's academy.json sets scientist.queue.mcpAdd to 'on') it writes nothing and returns the job file it would write.

tools.name: env_list

tools.name: env_check

tools.name: tickets_create
tools.description: File a ticket from the caller's instance (the human files as 'human'). The server allocates the id and dates; status is open. A ticket must pass the chain (docs/protocol.md section 5): to a neighbouring role, by a liaison; final_to names the role a relay forwards it to. campaign / cowork tag the ticket for a workplan (academy/lib/workplan.py): a campaign's target id or a cowork's slug.

budget.description: {runs: int >= 1} (default: the home's budget.ticketDefault runs); an optional max_model is an advisory note only, never a gate: an agent runs on its agent file's model

instance.description: The instance you act for (workspace.json), e.g. researcher@flat. Needed only when the server cannot tell (a cloud session, whose server runs outside the homes); default: the ticket's party of your role, the server's home, or the only instance of your role. A role agent can never act as 'human'.

tools.name: tickets_update
tools.description: Change a ticket: a status transition (with reason where the protocol needs one), owned fields, ## Ask / ## Result detail, and/or a thread note. Field ownership and transitions per docs/protocol.md. deliver: true (the receiver or the human, ticket open/accepted/in-progress, fields.result required) walks open -> accepted -> in-progress -> delivered in one call, writing the usual thread line per step; every hop must be allowed; not with another status. result is an alias of fields.result.

instance.description: The instance you act for (workspace.json), e.g. researcher@flat. Needed only when the server cannot tell (a cloud session, whose server runs outside the homes); default: the ticket's party of your role, the server's home, or the only instance of your role. A role agent can never act as 'human'.

tools.name: packets_list
tools.description: List review packets, filtered by instance / state / ticket, with their pending decisions.

tools.name: packets_get
tools.description: Read one packet with its parsed decisions and answers.

tools.name: packets_create
tools.description: Create a review packet from the caller's instance, from a full Markdown body or from sections. Required: title, kind, and body or sections; decisions as '### D1. question' with 2-4 '- (a) option' lines and a '- Recommendation:' line (or 'None.'). ## Decision must be empty. With ticket, the receiver's packet is also listed in the ticket's packets. A refusal lists every problem at once.

sections.description: summary (<=3 lines), produced, established_vs_assumed, evidence, extra {heading: text} (between Evidence and Decisions needed), decisions_needed ('None.' or ### D1. blocks), machine_notes

tools.name: packets_decide
tools.description: Human only: record the answer to decision D<k> (choice a-d, 'other' with a note, or D0 'ack'), set state decided when all are answered, and echo it into the packet's ticket.

tools.name: domain_get
tools.description: Read a domain pack file (notation.md, traps.md, theorems/INDEX.md, ...) by pack name; without file, list the pack's files.

tools.name: workspace_get
tools.description: The instance map (workspace.json) and who the caller is.

tools.name: config_get
tools.description: An instance's .claude/academy.json with defaults merged (default: the instance of the caller's home), and its role's agents resolved agent -> tier -> model for the workspace (models).
